lines.text: Hathach learns from Mordecai how much money Haman promised and receives a letter from Haman.

wrong_details.true: a copy of the written decree

lines.text: Anyone approaching the king uninvited in the inner court dies unless he extends the scepter; Esther went forty days unsummoned.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "the king's signet ring" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
The line still omits that the law applies to someone approaching the king in the inner court.
